business_problem: Barilla, the largest pasta producer in the world with 300+ different food products made in over 90 factories and distributed across 100+ countries, the need to adopt a more sustainable and resilient supply chain strategy was critical to mitigate these risks and protect operating margins. However, their legacy on-premises data warehouse was ill-equipped to scale their operations effectively, creating silos that impacted their ability to navigate a growing list of external threats to their operations.
solution_summary: Barilla, the largest pasta producer in the world with 300+ different food products made in over 90 factories and distributed across 100+ countries, the need to adopt a more sustainable and resilient supply chain strategy was critical to mitigate these risks and protect operating margins. However, their legacy on-premises data warehouse was ill-equipped to scale their operations effectively, creating silos that impacted their ability to navigate a growing list of external threats to their operations. Moving to the Databricks Data + AI Platform introduced a centralized architecture for data management and analytics, helping them deliver insights that improve all aspects of their business — from boosting manufacturing performance at lower costs, to streamlining logistics to improving sustainability, to delivering more targeted marketing campaigns.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Provides the Azure-based lakehouse workspace for ingesting, transforming, and serving governed data.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

data_flow: Transaction, dispute, and event data lands in Azure Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
